gaps.lead: You can only get a seat if you book well in advance.
gaps.explanation: if you don't book = without booking.

gaps.lead: 'I'll definitely call you when I land,' she told me.
gaps.explanation: Reported promise: promised to call; the person promised shifts to 'me'.

gaps.lead: The guidebook says this bridge is Roman.
gaps.explanation: be supposed to be = generally said or believed to be.

gaps.lead: 'Did you send the invoice?' the manager asked her.
gaps.explanation: if/whether + subject + backshifted verb: whether she had sent.

gaps.lead: He had just sat down when the phone rang.
gaps.explanation: No sooner had + subject + participle … than…

gaps.lead: The ceremony will take place in the cathedral.
gaps.explanation: Ceremonies are held: will be held (in a venue).
